title: Shopper Support Academy — Settling Not-Delivered Recoveries on Cartwise Shopper Batches Against Instant Cashouts
content:
The amount to be taken back from a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch for orders verified as not delivered, as it stands once any share and allowances have been applied to the not-delivered orders' share of the mileage posting, is finally settled by the not-delivered settlement method, which reads the shopper's payout account in Cartwise Shopper Payouts:

1. When the payout account paid out an **instant cashout less than one whole calendar month before the handling date** and its payout plan **charges a fee for instant cashouts**, the amount is **multiplied by 0.75 and rounded down to the cent**.
2. When such an instant cashout was paid and the plan **charges no instant-cashout fee**, the amount is **halved and rounded up to the cent**.
3. When no such instant cashout was paid, the amount is **rounded to the cent half up and taken back in full**.

## Training questions

**Which records are read?** The instant cashouts among the payout account's entries, and whether the account's payout plan carries an instant-cashout fee above zero.

**Does the plan's fee matter when no instant cashout was paid in the last month?** No — the amount is taken back in full, rounded half up.

**Which way does each branch round?** The fee-charging branch rounds down; the no-fee branch rounds up.

## Hypothetical figures (amount 1.95)

| Instant cashout paid less than one whole calendar month ago | Plan charges an instant-cashout fee | Taken back |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 1.95 multiplied by 0.75 is 1.4625, rounded down to 1.46 |
| Yes | No | 1.95 halved is 0.975, rounded up to 0.98 |
| No | Either | 1.95 |
